name: Cowardice
overview: Scripture reveals cowardice as a failure to trust God's protection and sovereignty, leading to fear-driven actions that compromise obedience and integrity. Adam's attempt to shift blame (Genesis 3:12) and Abraham and Isaac's fear-induced deception about their wives (Genesis 12:11; 20:2; 26:7) illustrate how cowardice distorts truth and invites peril. Jacob's flight from Laban (Genesis 31:31) and Aaron's yielding to the people's demands (Exodus 32:22) further demonstrate how fear can cause believers to avoid confrontation or responsibility, undermining God's purposes.
